name: The Scent of Green Papaya
description:
A young servant quietly observes the routines and relationships within a Vietnamese household.
The sensory drama finds beauty in domestic life, changing affection, nature, and patient attention.

name: Uncle Boonmee Who Can Recall His Past Lives
description:
A dying man spends his final days among relatives, spirits, and memories of earlier existences.
The Thai fantasy drama blends reincarnation, nature, family, politics, and dreamlike reflection.

name: The Secret in Their Eyes
description:
A retired investigator revisits an unresolved murder case and the emotions that shaped his earlier life.
The Argentine mystery combines romance, memory, justice, political tension, and long-held regret.

name: Wild Tales
description:
Six darkly comic stories follow ordinary people pushed beyond the limits of patience and restraint.
The Argentine anthology explores revenge, inequality, bureaucracy, anger, and social pressure.

name: Nine Queens
description:
Two con artists meet in Buenos Aires and attempt an elaborate deal involving rare stamps.
The Argentine crime comedy builds tension through deception, shifting trust, quick improvisation, and competing schemes.

name: The Official Story
description:
A history teacher begins questioning her adopted daughter's origins during Argentina's return to democracy.
The political drama examines denial, family, state violence, memory, and moral awakening.

name: Amores Perros
description:
A car crash connects several lives across Mexico City, each shaped by love, ambition, and loss.
The interwoven drama explores class, loyalty, violence, and the consequences of desperate choices.

name: Y Tu Mamá También
description:
Two teenage friends travel across Mexico with an older woman and discover tensions beneath their carefree lives.
The road drama examines desire, friendship, class, adulthood, and social inequality.

name: Roma
description:
A domestic worker cares for a middle-class family during a year of personal and political upheaval in Mexico City.
The intimate drama explores labor, motherhood, class, memory, and resilience.

name: The Motorcycle Diaries
description:
Two young men travel across South America and encounter communities far removed from their privileged lives.
The biographical road drama follows friendship, discovery, inequality, and growing political awareness.

name: Central Station
description:
A cynical letter writer reluctantly helps a boy search across Brazil for the father he has never known.
The road drama explores grief, trust, poverty, companionship, and unexpected tenderness.

name: Elite Squad
description:
A police captain searches for a replacement while confronting violent crime and corruption in Rio de Janeiro.
The Brazilian action drama examines institutional brutality, fear, loyalty, and moral compromise.

name: Bacurau
description:
Residents of a remote Brazilian town discover that their community has vanished from maps and attracted dangerous outsiders.
The genre-blending thriller combines resistance, western imagery, political satire, and collective survival.

name: Aquarius
description:
A retired music critic refuses to leave her apartment when developers attempt to take control of the building.
The Brazilian drama explores memory, property, aging, class, and personal resistance.

name: A Fantastic Woman
description:
A transgender singer faces grief and hostility after the sudden death of her partner.
The Chilean drama examines dignity, identity, prejudice, love, and the right to mourn.

name: No
description:
An advertising executive helps design an optimistic campaign against Chile's military dictatorship.
The political drama explores media strategy, public memory, compromise, and democratic change.

name: The Club
description:
Disgraced priests living in an isolated coastal house face scrutiny after a visitor disrupts their routine.
The Chilean drama examines institutional secrecy, guilt, denial, and moral accountability.

name: Embrace of the Serpent
description:
An Amazonian shaman guides two scientists through the rainforest on journeys separated by decades.
The Colombian adventure drama explores colonialism, memory, cultural loss, nature, and spiritual knowledge.

name: Monos
description:
Teenage commandos guard a captive and a valuable animal in an isolated Latin American landscape.
The war drama blends survival, group psychology, adolescence, and the breakdown of authority.

name: The Headless Woman
description:
An affluent woman becomes uncertain about what happened after a disturbing incident on a quiet road.
The Argentine psychological drama explores guilt, denial, class protection, and fragmented perception.

name: Argentina, 1985
description:
A legal team prosecutes leaders of Argentina's military dictatorship during the country's fragile return to democracy.
The courtroom drama emphasizes evidence, courage, public memory, and institutional justice.

name: Society of the Snow
description:
Survivors of a plane crash in the Andes confront extreme conditions and difficult collective decisions.
The survival drama focuses on endurance, cooperation, grief, faith, and human responsibility.

name: The Second Mother
description:
A live-in housekeeper's carefully ordered life changes when her confident daughter comes to stay.
The Brazilian drama examines class boundaries, domestic labor, motherhood, and social mobility.

name: The Milk of Sorrow
description:
A young Peruvian woman living with inherited fear seeks independence after a death in her family.
The drama explores trauma, cultural memory, exploitation, and gradual self-possession.

name: A Separation
description:
An Iranian couple's marital dispute draws two families into an escalating moral and legal conflict.
The drama examines truth, class, faith, caregiving, and the consequences of partial knowledge.

name: Children of Heaven
description:
A boy and his sister secretly share one pair of shoes after hers is accidentally lost.
The Iranian family drama finds suspense and tenderness in childhood responsibility, poverty, and sibling devotion.

name: The Salesman
description:
A married couple's relationship changes after a troubling incident in their new apartment.
The Iranian drama explores dignity, revenge, performance, trust, and conflicting responses to trauma.

name: Taste of Cherry
description:
A man drives around Tehran searching for someone willing to assist with a deeply personal plan.
The Iranian drama reflects on mortality, compassion, choice, and the ordinary textures of life.

name: Capernaum
description:
A neglected child survives on the streets of Beirut and challenges the adults responsible for his circumstances.
The Lebanese drama examines poverty, migration, childhood, and institutional abandonment.

name: Wadjda
description:
A spirited Saudi girl enters a school competition hoping to earn enough money for a bicycle.
The coming-of-age drama explores determination, gender expectations, family, and everyday resistance.

name: The Battle of Algiers
description:
Resistance fighters and French forces struggle for control during Algeria's fight for independence.
The historical drama presents urban warfare, colonialism, political organization, and civilian consequences with documentary intensity.

name: Timbuktu
description:
Residents near an ancient Malian city endure daily life under the restrictive rule of armed extremists.
The drama portrays cultural resilience, faith, family, oppression, and quiet forms of resistance.

name: Tsotsi
description:
A violent young criminal in Johannesburg is forced to confront responsibility after an impulsive act.
The South African drama explores poverty, trauma, empathy, and the possibility of change.

name: District 9
description:
Alien refugees confined near Johannesburg become the center of political, corporate, and social conflict.
The science-fiction thriller uses action and body horror to examine segregation, exploitation, and prejudice.

name: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
description:
A rebellious boy and his reluctant foster uncle become the subjects of a wilderness search across New Zealand.
The adventure comedy combines found family, grief, survival, and offbeat humor.

name: The Piano
description:
A mute pianist arrives in nineteenth-century New Zealand for an arranged marriage and struggles for autonomy.
The period drama explores desire, expression, power, isolation, and emotional freedom.

name: Theeb
description:
A Bedouin boy crosses the Arabian desert during wartime and is forced into unfamiliar dangers.
The Jordanian coming-of-age western explores survival, trust, tradition, and a changing region.

name: Blade Runner
description:
A weary detective hunts artificial humans hiding in a rain-soaked future city.
The science-fiction noir examines memory, identity, mortality, and what it means to be human.

name: 2001: A Space Odyssey
description:
A mysterious object connects humanity's distant past to a perilous voyage beyond Earth.
The cerebral science-fiction epic explores evolution, technology, isolation, and the unknown.

name: The Martian
description:
An astronaut stranded on Mars relies on science and ingenuity while Earth plans a rescue.
The survival adventure balances technical problem-solving, humor, teamwork, and hope.

name: Gravity
description:
Two astronauts struggle to survive after disaster leaves them drifting above Earth.
The tense space thriller focuses on isolation, resilience, grief, and the will to return home.

name: Edge of Tomorrow
description:
A reluctant soldier repeatedly relives the same battle against an alien invasion.
The science-fiction action film combines time loops, dark humor, teamwork, and personal growth.

name: Ex Machina
description:
A programmer is invited to evaluate an advanced artificial intelligence in a secluded home.
The intimate thriller probes consciousness, manipulation, power, and the ethics of creation.

name: Children of Men
description:
In a world facing human extinction, a disillusioned man protects an unexpected source of hope.
The dystopian thriller explores migration, authoritarianism, sacrifice, and fragile optimism.

name: Minority Report
description:
A police officer enforcing prediction-based justice becomes accused of a future crime.
The science-fiction mystery questions free will, surveillance, guilt, and institutional power.

name: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
description:
A lonely child secretly befriends a gentle alien stranded far from home.
The family science-fiction adventure celebrates friendship, empathy, wonder, and saying goodbye.

name: Contact
description:
A determined astronomer detects a message that may prove humanity is not alone.
The thoughtful science-fiction drama considers faith, evidence, wonder, and our place in the universe.

name: Moon
description:
A solitary worker nearing the end of a lunar assignment begins questioning his reality.
The restrained science-fiction mystery explores identity, labor, memory, and corporate control.

name: The Terminator
description:
A relentless machine arrives from the future to alter the course of human history.
The lean science-fiction thriller blends pursuit, fate, technology, and survival.

name: RoboCop
description:
A critically injured officer is transformed into a corporate-controlled law-enforcement machine.
The satirical action film examines identity, privatization, media, and dehumanizing violence.

name: Total Recall
description:
A construction worker's implanted vacation memories uncover doubts about his identity and past.
The science-fiction action mystery plays with reality, rebellion, paranoia, and personal choice.

name: Starship Troopers
description:
Young recruits join a militarized society's interplanetary war against an insect-like enemy.
The action spectacle uses satire to examine propaganda, citizenship, conformity, and fascism.

name: Planet of the Apes
description:
Astronauts land on a strange world where intelligent apes dominate human survivors.
The science-fiction adventure explores prejudice, civilization, power, and humanity's destructive habits.

name: Looper
description:
A hired killer faces an impossible assignment when his future self becomes the target.
The time-travel thriller combines crime, consequence, sacrifice, and the possibility of change.

name: Annihilation
description:
A biologist enters a quarantined region where nature transforms in unsettling ways.
The science-fiction horror film explores grief, self-destruction, mutation, and the limits of understanding.

name: Dune
description:
A gifted heir enters a dangerous desert world central to an interstellar struggle for power.
The science-fiction epic examines destiny, colonialism, ecology, family, and political ambition.

name: Dune: Part Two
description:
A displaced heir joins desert fighters while navigating prophecy, love, and a growing war.
The expansive science-fiction drama explores revenge, faith, leadership, and the danger of messianic power.

name: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
description:
Separated companions face gathering armies as the struggle for Middle-earth intensifies.
The fantasy adventure emphasizes loyalty, courage, temptation, and resistance against overwhelming power.

name: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
description:
Allies make a final stand while two travelers approach the heart of enemy territory.
The fantasy epic brings together sacrifice, friendship, mercy, and the burden of power.

name: Star Wars: A New Hope
description:
A farm boy joins rebels, smugglers, and mystics opposing a vast galactic empire.
The space fantasy celebrates adventure, friendship, courage, and hope against tyranny.

name: The Empire Strikes Back
description:
Rebel heroes are scattered while a young warrior trains and confronts a painful truth.
The darker space adventure explores temptation, identity, loyalty, and the cost of resistance.

name: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story
description:
A group of unlikely rebels attempts to steal plans for a devastating imperial weapon.
The space-war adventure focuses on sacrifice, solidarity, moral courage, and ordinary people resisting oppression.

name: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
description:
An orphan discovers a hidden magical world and begins school among new friends and dangers.
The family fantasy introduces wonder, belonging, courage, and the power of friendship.

name: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
description:
A young wizard confronts escaped threats while learning that familiar stories hide deeper truths.
The fantasy mystery explores fear, memory, loyalty, and growing emotional complexity.

name: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
description:
A resourceful blacksmith joins an eccentric pirate to rescue a kidnapped governor's daughter.
The supernatural adventure mixes swordplay, romance, curses, and playful maritime comedy.

name: The Mummy
description:
Adventurers exploring an ancient Egyptian city accidentally awaken a powerful cursed priest.
The energetic fantasy blends archaeological adventure, horror, romance, and comedy.

name: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
description:
Four siblings enter a magical land trapped in winter under a cruel ruler.
The family fantasy explores bravery, betrayal, forgiveness, and the struggle between hope and oppression.

name: Stardust
description:
A young man crosses into a magical kingdom to retrieve a fallen star for someone he loves.
The romantic fantasy combines witches, sky pirates, adventure, humor, and unexpected self-discovery.

name: The Green Knight
description:
An impulsive young knight journeys to fulfill a dangerous promise made to a mysterious challenger.
The atmospheric fantasy reflects on honor, mortality, courage, and the stories people tell about themselves.

name: The Shape of Water
description:
A quiet cleaner at a secret laboratory forms a bond with an imprisoned aquatic being.
The romantic fantasy explores loneliness, otherness, compassion, and resistance to cruelty.

name: The Wizard of Oz
description:
A girl swept away by a storm travels through a magical land seeking a path home.
The musical fantasy celebrates friendship, courage, imagination, and appreciating where one belongs.

name: Willy Wonka & the Chocolate Factory
description:
A kind child wins entry to an eccentric confectioner's mysterious and wondrous factory.
The musical family fantasy mixes imagination, moral lessons, dark humor, and childhood wonder.

name: Labyrinth
description:
A teenager enters a shifting magical maze to rescue her baby brother from a goblin king.
The fantasy adventure explores responsibility, temptation, imagination, and growing up.

name: King Kong
description:
A filmmaking expedition discovers a colossal creature whose capture brings tragedy to a modern city.
The adventure epic combines spectacle with themes of exploitation, obsession, beauty, and loss.

name: Iron Man
description:
A weapons inventor builds an armored suit and begins reconsidering the consequences of his work.
The superhero adventure blends technology, humor, responsibility, and personal reinvention.

name: Logan
description:
An aging mutant reluctantly protects a young girl while confronting violence and a fading legacy.
The somber superhero western explores family, mortality, regret, and redemption.

name: Guardians of the Galaxy
description:
A band of interstellar misfits reluctantly unites around an object that could threaten countless worlds.
The space adventure mixes humor, action, found family, and unlikely heroism.

name: Aliens
description:
A survivor returns to a distant colony with soldiers after contact with its residents is lost.
The science-fiction action horror film explores trauma, leadership, motherhood, and survival.

name: Predator
description:
An elite rescue team in a remote jungle realizes it is being hunted by an unseen opponent.
The action thriller combines military tension, science fiction, primal fear, and survival.

name: The Fly
description:
A brilliant scientist's teleportation experiment begins transforming his body in horrifying ways.
The tragic body-horror film examines ambition, illness, intimacy, and loss of self.

name: Nope
description:
Siblings running a remote horse ranch investigate a strange presence in the sky.
The science-fiction horror mystery examines spectacle, exploitation, fear, and humanity's urge to capture the unbelievable.

name: Us
description:
A family's peaceful vacation turns terrifying when uncanny doubles appear outside their home.
The horror thriller explores identity, inequality, buried trauma, and the fear of oneself.

name: The Babadook
description:
A grieving mother and her son are haunted by a disturbing figure from a children's book.
The psychological horror film explores parenthood, isolation, anger, and unresolved grief.

name: Hereditary
description:
A family discovers increasingly disturbing secrets after the death of its secretive matriarch.
The psychological horror drama examines inherited trauma, grief, guilt, and loss of control.

name: Midsommar
description:
A troubled couple visits an isolated summer festival whose traditions become deeply unsettling.
The daylight folk-horror film explores grief, dependency, belonging, and emotional manipulation.

name: The Witch
description:
A banished family in colonial New England faces fear and suspicion near a dark forest.
The folk-horror drama explores religious dread, repression, family conflict, and autonomy.

name: It Follows
description:
A young woman is pursued by a supernatural presence that slowly assumes different human forms.
The atmospheric horror film examines anxiety, intimacy, mortality, and inescapable consequence.

name: The Conjuring
description:
Paranormal investigators help a family facing a hostile presence in an isolated farmhouse.
The supernatural horror film builds tension through faith, family bonds, and unseen danger.

name: Scream
description:
A masked killer targets teenagers who understand the rules and clichés of horror movies.
The sharp slasher blends suspense, dark comedy, self-awareness, and mystery.

name: Halloween
description:
An escaped killer returns to a quiet town and stalks teenagers on Halloween night.
The minimalist slasher creates dread through suspense, vulnerability, and an apparently unstoppable threat.

name: A Nightmare on Elm Street
description:
Teenagers discover that a killer can attack them inside their dreams.
The supernatural slasher turns sleep into a battleground of fear, imagination, and survival.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre
description:
A group of young travelers encounters a terrifying family in the rural countryside.
The raw horror film creates relentless tension around isolation, violence, and social decay.

name: The Blair Witch Project
description:
Student filmmakers disappear while investigating a local legend in a Maryland forest.
The found-footage horror film uses uncertainty, darkness, and disorientation to create mounting dread.

name: Saw
description:
Two strangers awaken in a locked room and face a cruel test designed by an unseen captor.
The horror mystery combines moral dilemmas, desperation, elaborate traps, and a race against time.

name: The Cabin in the Woods
description:
A weekend retreat follows familiar horror patterns until a larger design begins to emerge.
The inventive horror comedy plays with genre conventions, manipulation, sacrifice, and audience expectations.

name: Shaun of the Dead
description:
An unmotivated salesman tries to save his loved ones during a sudden zombie outbreak.
The horror comedy balances friendship, romance, ordinary frustration, and bloody survival.

name: The Lighthouse
description:
Two lighthouse keepers on a remote island descend into conflict and uncertainty.
The psychological horror drama explores isolation, power, guilt, myth, and unreliable perception.

name: The Incredibles
description:
A family of retired superheroes struggles with ordinary life before a new threat emerges.
The animated adventure explores family roles, identity, teamwork, and the desire to use one's gifts.

name: Ratatouille
description:
A gifted rat secretly pursues his passion for cooking in a celebrated Paris restaurant.
The animated comedy celebrates creativity, mentorship, persistence, and talent from unexpected places.

name: Finding Nemo
description:
An anxious father crosses the ocean to find his young son after they are separated.
The animated adventure explores parenthood, trust, courage, friendship, and letting go.

name: Up
description:
An elderly widower lifts his home into the sky and unexpectedly gains a young companion.
The animated adventure balances grief, friendship, wonder, and opening oneself to a new life.

name: Inside Out
description:
The emotions inside a young girl's mind struggle to guide her through a difficult move.
The animated family film makes room for sadness while exploring memory, change, and emotional growth.

name: Monsters, Inc.
description:
Two factory workers in a monster world encounter a human child who changes their assumptions.
The animated comedy explores friendship, fear, empathy, and questioning an unjust system.

name: Shrek
description:
A solitary ogre reluctantly undertakes a rescue mission alongside an endlessly talkative donkey.
The animated fairy-tale comedy celebrates self-acceptance, friendship, and looking beyond appearances.

name: How to Train Your Dragon
description:
A young Viking befriends an injured dragon despite his community's fear of the creatures.
The animated fantasy explores empathy, courage, family expectations, and changing inherited beliefs.

name: Kubo and the Two Strings
description:
A young storyteller begins a magical quest to uncover his family's history and protect himself.
The stop-motion fantasy explores memory, grief, courage, and the enduring power of stories.

name: Coraline
description:
A curious girl discovers an inviting alternate home that hides a controlling and sinister purpose.
The stop-motion fantasy blends wonder and horror while exploring family, bravery, and deceptive perfection.

name: The Iron Giant
description:
A boy befriends a massive robot from space while government agents close in.
The animated science-fiction drama explores friendship, fear, sacrifice, and choosing who one becomes.

name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
description:
A disconnected family road trip becomes humanity's unlikely defense against a machine uprising.
The animated comedy celebrates imperfect families, creativity, technology, and reconnecting with one another.

name: The Lego Movie
description:
An ordinary construction worker is mistaken for the hero destined to save a block-built world.
The animated comedy mixes imagination, teamwork, satire, and the joy of creating freely.

name: The Nightmare Before Christmas
description:
The ruler of a Halloween world becomes fascinated with Christmas and tries to recreate it.
The stop-motion musical explores curiosity, identity, creativity, and appreciating one's own strengths.

name: Beauty and the Beast
description:
A book-loving young woman becomes the guest of a cursed prince in an enchanted castle.
The animated musical fairy tale explores compassion, transformation, freedom, and love beyond appearances.

name: Aladdin
description:
A kind street thief discovers a magical lamp and tries to win a princess's heart.
The animated musical adventure explores honesty, freedom, friendship, and being comfortable with oneself.

name: Mulan
description:
A young woman secretly takes her father's place when her country calls men to war.
The animated adventure explores duty, courage, identity, and challenging restrictive expectations.

name: Moana
description:
A determined islander sails beyond familiar waters to restore balance to her threatened home.
The animated musical adventure celebrates heritage, exploration, leadership, and finding one's calling.

name: Encanto
description:
A girl without magical powers tries to understand why her extraordinary family's home is weakening.
The animated musical explores family pressure, intergenerational pain, belonging, and honest communication.

name: Soul
description:
A music teacher separated from his body reevaluates what makes a life meaningful.
The animated fantasy reflects on purpose, passion, everyday joy, and being present.

name: Airplane!
description:
A nervous former pilot must help land a passenger plane after the crew becomes ill.
The rapid-fire comedy parodies disaster films through absurd wordplay, visual jokes, and deadpan performances.

name: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
description:
King Arthur and his knights face ridiculous obstacles while searching for a sacred relic.
The irreverent comedy dismantles heroic legend through absurdity, wordplay, and anarchic imagination.

name: Monty Python's Life of Brian
description:
An ordinary man born near a famous religious figure is repeatedly mistaken for a messiah.
The satirical comedy examines conformity, authority, belief, and humanity's talent for misunderstanding.

name: This Is Spinal Tap
description:
A documentary crew follows an aging rock band through an increasingly disastrous tour.
The mockumentary comedy affectionately satirizes ego, celebrity, creative conflict, and music-industry excess.

name: Hot Fuzz
description:
An exceptional city police officer is transferred to a picturesque village with suspiciously little crime.
The action comedy blends mystery, friendship, genre parody, and elaborately staged chaos.

name: Bridesmaids
description:
A struggling woman tries to support her best friend's wedding while competing with a polished new acquaintance.
The ensemble comedy explores friendship, insecurity, adulthood, and spectacular social embarrassment.

name: Superbad
description:
Two inseparable teenagers chase one memorable night before graduation sends them in different directions.
The coming-of-age comedy mixes crude mishaps with friendship, anxiety, and fear of change.

name: The Hangover
description:
Friends awaken after a chaotic celebration with no memory and one missing member of their group.
The comedy follows their frantic reconstruction of the night through escalating clues and consequences.

name: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
description:
A self-important television newsman feels threatened when an ambitious woman joins his team.
The absurd workplace comedy satirizes vanity, sexism, rivalry, and broadcast culture.

name: Tropic Thunder
description:
Actors making a war movie are dropped into real danger without fully understanding the situation.
The action comedy satirizes Hollywood ego, performance, awards culture, and reckless filmmaking.

name: Office Space
description:
A frustrated office worker stops caring about his job and accidentally becomes management material.
The workplace comedy captures bureaucracy, alienation, friendship, and fantasies of escaping corporate routine.

name: Napoleon Dynamite
description:
An awkward teenager navigates school, family oddities, and a friend's campaign for class president.
The understated comedy finds warmth in eccentricity, loyalty, confidence, and small-town life.

name: Borat
description:
A fictional foreign reporter travels across America while exposing the prejudices of people he meets.
The provocative mockumentary uses discomfort, improvisation, and satire to examine culture and hypocrisy.

name: Palm Springs
description:
Two wedding guests become trapped reliving the same day and develop an unexpected connection.
The romantic comedy uses a time loop to explore commitment, loneliness, meaning, and change.

name: When Harry Met Sally...
description:
Two acquaintances cross paths over many years while debating whether friendship can remain uncomplicated.
The romantic comedy explores timing, intimacy, compatibility, and the gradual growth of love.

name: Notting Hill
description:
A quiet London bookseller begins a relationship with one of the world's most famous actors.
The romantic comedy explores privacy, celebrity, vulnerability, and affection across very different lives.

name: Crazy Rich Asians
description:
A professor travels with her boyfriend to Singapore and discovers his family's extraordinary wealth.
The romantic comedy explores cultural identity, family expectations, class, and choosing one's own future.

name: My Big Fat Greek Wedding
description:
A woman from a close-knit Greek family falls for a man outside her community.
The romantic comedy celebrates family chaos, cultural tradition, self-confidence, and compromise.

name: The 40-Year-Old Virgin
description:
Well-meaning coworkers try to transform a shy man's romantic life after learning his secret.
The comedy balances awkward humor with friendship, emotional honesty, and adult vulnerability.

name: Trading Places
description:
Wealthy financiers secretly swap the circumstances of a privileged employee and a street hustler.
The social comedy uses reversal and revenge to satirize class, markets, prejudice, and inherited advantage.

name: The Godfather Part II
description:
A crime boss consolidates power as the story of his father's rise unfolds in parallel.
The sweeping drama examines family, ambition, immigration, loyalty, and the isolating cost of control.

name: Heat
description:
A meticulous detective pursues an equally disciplined professional thief through Los Angeles.
The crime thriller explores obsession, loneliness, respect, and the personal cost of total commitment.

name: L.A. Confidential
description:
Three very different police officers investigate corruption beneath glamorous postwar Los Angeles.
The noir mystery examines ambition, violence, celebrity, justice, and compromised institutions.

name: The Usual Suspects
description:
A survivor recounts how a group of criminals became entangled with a legendary underworld figure.
The crime mystery plays with unreliable storytelling, manipulation, fear, and hidden identity.

name: Reservoir Dogs
description:
Criminals regroup after a failed robbery and suspect that one of them is an informant.
The tense crime drama explores distrust, loyalty, violence, and fractured professionalism.

name: Fargo
description:
A desperate man's poorly planned crime collides with a quietly determined police chief.
The darkly comic thriller contrasts greed and brutality with decency, patience, and ordinary life.

name: Mystic River
description:
A murder reunites childhood friends whose lives were shaped by an earlier trauma.
The crime drama examines grief, suspicion, vengeance, community, and the lasting damage of violence.

name: Prisoners
description:
A desperate father takes extreme action when two children disappear and the investigation stalls.
The dark thriller explores morality, grief, obsession, faith, and the limits of justice.

name: Gone Girl
description:
A woman's disappearance turns her marriage into a national spectacle and her husband into a suspect.
The psychological mystery examines performance, resentment, media narratives, and intimate manipulation.

name: Zodiac
description:
Reporters and investigators become consumed by the long search for an elusive serial killer.
The procedural thriller focuses on obsession, uncertainty, evidence, and lives shaped by an unsolved case.

name: Nightcrawler
description:
An ambitious outsider discovers that filming violent nighttime news can be highly profitable.
The dark thriller satirizes media ethics, exploitation, capitalism, and ruthless self-invention.

name: Collateral
description:
A taxi driver is forced to transport a professional killer through one dangerous night.
The urban thriller explores isolation, chance, courage, and the lives people postpone.

name: Sicario
description:
An idealistic agent joins a secretive operation targeting a powerful drug network near the border.
The crime thriller examines moral compromise, institutional violence, fear, and hidden agendas.

name: Wind River
description:
A wildlife tracker helps investigate a young woman's death on a remote reservation.
The wintry crime drama explores grief, neglected communities, justice, and survival in an unforgiving landscape.

name: Hell or High Water
description:
Two brothers rob banks across West Texas while a veteran ranger follows their trail.
The modern western explores economic desperation, family loyalty, justice, and communities left behind.

name: The Town
description:
A skilled bank robber's growing attachment to a witness threatens his crew and planned escape.
The crime thriller explores loyalty, inherited violence, identity, and the hope of starting over.

name: Inside Man
description:
A detective negotiates with a clever bank robber whose carefully planned siege hides another purpose.
The crime thriller combines strategy, corruption, social tension, and shifting assumptions.

name: Ocean's Eleven
description:
A charismatic thief assembles a specialist team to rob three casinos in one night.
The stylish heist comedy celebrates teamwork, confidence, clever planning, and playful deception.

name: Catch Me If You Can
description:
A gifted young impersonator travels widely while a persistent federal agent follows his trail.
The crime comedy-drama explores reinvention, loneliness, mentorship, and the appeal of deception.

name: Chinatown
description:
A private detective investigating an affair uncovers a deeper conspiracy involving water and power.
The neo-noir mystery explores corruption, wealth, helplessness, and the darkness beneath civic respectability.

name: Casablanca
description:
An American expatriate in wartime Morocco must choose between lost love and a larger cause.
The romantic drama explores sacrifice, regret, resistance, and moral responsibility.

name: Citizen Kane
description:
A reporter investigates the final word of a powerful publisher whose life was marked by ambition and isolation.
The drama examines memory, wealth, media influence, and the limits of knowing another person.

name: Sunset Boulevard
description:
A struggling screenwriter becomes entangled with a forgotten silent-film star longing for a comeback.
The dark Hollywood drama explores fame, denial, exploitation, and the cruelty of an industry obsessed with youth.

name: Rear Window
description:
A photographer confined to his apartment begins suspecting that a neighbor committed murder.
The suspense mystery examines voyeurism, curiosity, relationships, and the uncertainty of observation.

name: Vertigo
description:
A retired detective becomes obsessed with a mysterious woman he was hired to follow.
The psychological mystery explores desire, identity, control, illusion, and destructive fixation.

name: North by Northwest
description:
An advertising executive mistaken for a spy is chased across the country by dangerous agents.
The adventure thriller combines mistaken identity, romance, suspense, and elegant humor.

name: Psycho
description:
A traveler seeking a fresh start stops at an isolated motel run by a nervous young man.
The psychological horror film explores secrecy, guilt, identity, and terror hidden within ordinary places.

name: Double Indemnity
description:
An insurance salesman is drawn into a plan to murder a wealthy woman's husband.
The film noir examines greed, desire, betrayal, suspicion, and the tightening consequences of crime.

name: Some Like It Hot
description:
Two musicians disguise themselves to join an all-women band while fleeing dangerous gangsters.
The classic comedy mixes romance, mistaken identity, performance, and rapid-fire farce.

name: Singin' in the Rain
description:
Silent-film stars struggle to adapt when talking pictures transform the movie industry.
The joyful musical celebrates performance, creativity, romance, and the chaos behind Hollywood glamour.

name: Roman Holiday
description:
A sheltered princess escapes official duties and explores Rome with an American reporter.
The romantic comedy balances freedom, affection, responsibility, and the bittersweet limits of circumstance.

name: It's a Wonderful Life
description:
A discouraged man is shown how deeply his ordinary life has affected his community.
The holiday drama explores sacrifice, connection, despair, gratitude, and the value of everyday kindness.

name: On the Waterfront
description:
A former boxer working on the docks faces pressure to remain silent about union corruption.
The social drama examines conscience, loyalty, intimidation, dignity, and moral courage.

name: All About Eve
description:
An ambitious admirer enters the inner circle of an established stage actor and quietly pursues her career.
The sharp drama explores fame, aging, performance, rivalry, and calculated ambition.

name: One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
description:
A rebellious patient challenges the rigid authority controlling life inside a psychiatric institution.
The drama explores freedom, conformity, solidarity, power, and the costs of resistance.

name: Taxi Driver
description:
An isolated veteran driving nights through New York becomes increasingly consumed by anger and delusion.
The psychological drama examines loneliness, alienation, violence, and distorted ideas of rescue.

name: Network
description:
A television anchor's public breakdown becomes profitable entertainment for an ambitious network.
The media satire examines corporate power, outrage, exploitation, and the conversion of reality into spectacle.

name: Dog Day Afternoon
description:
An inexperienced bank robbery turns into a prolonged public standoff on a hot city afternoon.
The crime drama blends tension and humor while exploring desperation, media attention, and human vulnerability.

name: Rocky
description:
A struggling boxer receives an unlikely opportunity to face the heavyweight champion.
The sports drama focuses on dignity, discipline, romance, and proving one's worth beyond winning.

name: Raging Bull
description:
A gifted boxer's violent jealousy and insecurity damage his career and closest relationships.
The uncompromising drama explores masculinity, self-destruction, fame, and the search for redemption.

name: Schindler's List
description:
A German industrialist gradually risks his fortune and safety to protect Jewish workers during the Holocaust.
The historical drama confronts genocide, complicity, moral awakening, and the value of individual lives.

name: 12 Years a Slave
description:
A free Black musician is kidnapped and forced into slavery in the American South.
The historical drama portrays endurance, dehumanization, identity, and the brutality of an unjust system.

name: Lincoln
description:
A wartime president works to abolish slavery while navigating a divided legislature and country.
The historical drama explores political compromise, moral purpose, leadership, and democratic process.

name: Malcolm X
description:
A charismatic activist's life evolves through crime, faith, leadership, and ideological transformation.
The biographical drama examines racism, identity, self-education, political awakening, and legacy.

name: Gandhi
description:
A lawyer develops a movement of nonviolent resistance against colonial rule in India.
The historical biography explores conscience, leadership, mass politics, sacrifice, and the contradictions of national change.

name: Hidden Figures
description:
Black women mathematicians at NASA overcome institutional barriers while supporting the early space program.
The historical drama celebrates intellect, persistence, teamwork, and challenges to racism and sexism.

name: Spotlight
description:
Investigative reporters uncover widespread abuse and institutional concealment within a powerful church.
The journalism drama emphasizes patient research, accountability, teamwork, and the courage of survivors.

name: All the President's Men
description:
Two reporters follow a political break-in toward a conspiracy reaching the highest levels of government.
The procedural drama focuses on verification, persistence, anonymous sources, and democratic accountability.

name: Argo
description:
A specialist creates an unlikely film production as cover for rescuing diplomats from a hostage crisis.
The historical thriller combines deception, international tension, teamwork, and a race against discovery.

name: Zero Dark Thirty
description:
An intelligence analyst spends years pursuing the hidden leader of a terrorist organization.
The procedural thriller examines obsession, secrecy, contested methods, and the human cost of prolonged pursuit.

name: The Hurt Locker
description:
A bomb-disposal team navigates deadly assignments and strained relationships during the Iraq War.
The war drama explores risk, adrenaline, trauma, and the difficulty of returning to ordinary life.

name: Platoon
description:
A young volunteer in Vietnam is caught between commanders with opposing moral approaches to war.
The combat drama examines fear, loyalty, brutality, disillusionment, and conflict within one's own side.

name: Full Metal Jacket
description:
Young recruits endure dehumanizing training before confronting the chaos of the Vietnam War.
The war drama explores institutional conditioning, identity, cruelty, and emotional detachment.

name: Apocalypse Now
description:
An officer travels deep into a war zone to find a commander who has abandoned military authority.
The hallucinatory war epic examines madness, imperial power, moral collapse, and the darkness of violence.

Two young soldiers cross enemy territory to deliver a message that could prevent a massacre.
The immersive war thriller emphasizes urgency, endurance, friendship, and courage under relentless pressure.

name: Dunkirk
description:
Soldiers, pilots, and civilians converge during the desperate evacuation of an encircled army.
The war thriller portrays survival, collective effort, fear, and heroism across land, sea, and air.

name: The Thin Red Line
description:
American soldiers fight for a Pacific island while reflecting on nature, fear, and human violence.
The meditative war drama contrasts inner life and natural beauty with destruction and military duty.

name: Lawrence of Arabia
description:
A British officer becomes deeply involved in an Arab revolt during the First World War.
The historical epic explores identity, charisma, colonialism, ambition, and the mythology of leadership.

name: The Bridge on the River Kwai
description:
Prisoners of war are forced to build a railway bridge while competing ideas of duty take hold.
The war drama examines pride, discipline, collaboration, obsession, and the absurdity of conflict.

name: Oppenheimer
description:
A physicist leads the development of an unprecedented weapon and later confronts its political and moral aftermath.
The historical drama explores scientific ambition, responsibility, power, and public judgment.

name: There Will Be Blood
description:
An ambitious oil prospector builds an empire while clashing with a charismatic preacher.
The period drama examines capitalism, faith, family, greed, and corrosive isolation.

name: Boogie Nights
description:
A directionless young man finds fame and a surrogate family in the adult-film industry.
The ensemble drama explores ambition, belonging, excess, exploitation, and changing cultural tastes.

name: The Master
description:
A troubled veteran falls under the influence of a charismatic leader building a spiritual movement.
The psychological drama explores control, belief, trauma, friendship, and the desire for direction.

name: Magnolia
description:
Interconnected people across Los Angeles confront regret, illness, loneliness, and unexpected coincidence.
The ensemble drama explores forgiveness, family wounds, chance, and the need for human connection.

name: Birdman
description:
A former superhero star risks his reputation and sanity while mounting an ambitious Broadway play.
The dark comedy examines ego, artistic relevance, family strain, and the hunger for recognition.

name: The Revenant
description:
A wounded frontiersman struggles through a brutal wilderness after being abandoned by his companions.
The survival drama explores endurance, revenge, grief, and humanity's fragile place in nature.

name: The Irishman
description:
An aging truck driver looks back on decades spent serving organized crime and powerful labor figures.
The crime epic reflects on loyalty, violence, regret, aging, and the emptiness left by a ruthless life.

name: Killers of the Flower Moon
description:
A series of deaths within a wealthy Indigenous community reveals an intimate conspiracy driven by greed.
The historical crime drama examines exploitation, racism, complicity, marriage, and institutional betrayal.

name: Manchester by the Sea
description:
A withdrawn handyman returns to his hometown after a death forces him to face family responsibility.
The drama explores grief, guilt, care, and the reality that some wounds do not neatly heal.

name: Aftersun
description:
A woman remembers a childhood holiday with her young father and reconsiders what she could not then understand.
The intimate drama explores memory, parenthood, depression, love, and the distance between experience and recollection.

name: Nomadland
description:
A woman travels through the American West taking temporary work after losing her hometown and livelihood.
The quiet drama explores economic precarity, grief, freedom, community, and life outside conventional stability.

name: Sound of Metal
description:
A drummer experiencing rapid hearing loss must reconsider his music, relationships, and sense of self.
The drama explores disability, addiction recovery, acceptance, communication, and the search for stillness.

name: The Florida Project
description:
A lively child finds adventure around a budget motel while her young mother struggles to survive.
The compassionate drama contrasts childhood wonder with poverty, insecurity, community, and adult desperation.

name: Room
description:
A mother and her young son endure confinement before facing the unfamiliar world beyond it.
The drama explores survival, trauma, parenthood, freedom, and the difficult process of recovery.

name: The Father
description:
An aging man experiencing dementia struggles to understand shifting people, spaces, and memories.
The intimate drama portrays confusion, vulnerability, family strain, and the erosion of a stable reality.

name: The Wrestler
description:
An aging professional wrestler tries to rebuild his life and relationships outside the ring.
The character drama explores identity, physical decline, loneliness, performance, and the pull of familiar applause.

name: The Whale
description:
A reclusive teacher living with severe obesity attempts to reconnect with his estranged daughter.
The chamber drama examines shame, grief, compassion, faith, and the need for honest connection.

name: The Green Mile
description:
A prison guard encounters a condemned man whose extraordinary gift challenges assumptions about guilt and grace.
The supernatural drama explores compassion, injustice, mortality, and moral responsibility.

name: The Curious Case of Benjamin Button
description:
A man who ages backward experiences love, loss, travel, and the passage of time in an unusual order.
The romantic fantasy reflects on mortality, change, memory, and relationships that cannot escape time.

name: Cast Away
description:
A time-obsessed delivery executive becomes stranded alone on a remote island.
The survival drama explores isolation, adaptation, hope, and returning to a world that continued without him.

name: Before Sunrise
description:
Two young travelers meet on a train and spend one night walking and talking through Vienna.
The romantic drama explores connection, possibility, time, and the intimacy of honest conversation.

name: Before Sunset
description:
Former travelers reunite years later and walk through Paris with limited time to confront their past.
The romantic drama explores memory, regret, adult compromise, and feelings that never fully disappeared.

name: About Time
description:
A young man able to revisit moments in his life uses the gift to pursue love and repair mistakes.
The romantic fantasy becomes a reflection on family, loss, gratitude, and appreciating ordinary days.

name: The Notebook
description:
A passionate romance between two young people is tested by class expectations, separation, and time.
The romantic drama explores memory, devotion, family pressure, and enduring love.

name: Atonement
description:
A young girl's damaging accusation alters several lives on the eve of war.
The romantic period drama explores guilt, imagination, class, loss, and the limits of artistic redemption.

name: Carol
description:
An aspiring photographer and an older woman form a deep connection in a restrictive era.
The romantic drama explores desire, social pressure, independence, and the courage to choose an authentic life.

name: Brokeback Mountain
description:
Two ranch workers form an intimate bond that continues across years of separate lives.
The romantic drama explores repression, longing, masculinity, social judgment, and lasting love.

name: Silver Linings Playbook
description:
Two emotionally struggling people form an unpredictable partnership around a dance competition.
The romantic comedy-drama explores mental health, family, recovery, honesty, and unconventional connection.

name: Jerry Maguire
description:
A sports agent's crisis of conscience costs him his career and pushes him toward a more honest life.
The romantic comedy-drama explores ambition, loyalty, intimacy, and redefining success.

name: Moneyball
description:
A baseball executive challenges tradition by building a competitive team through statistical analysis.
The sports drama explores innovation, resistance, leadership, value, and changing how talent is understood.

name: Remember the Titans
description:
A newly integrated high-school football team faces racial tension under demanding new leadership.
The sports drama emphasizes teamwork, prejudice, discipline, friendship, and community change.

name: Creed
description:
A young boxer seeks training from an aging champion while trying to build an identity beyond his family name.
The sports drama explores legacy, mentorship, grief, love, and earning one's own place.

name: Rush
description:
Two contrasting Formula One drivers push each other through a fierce and dangerous rivalry.
The racing drama explores ambition, fear, discipline, respect, and different approaches to risk.

name: The Fighter
description:
A boxer tries to revive his career while navigating loyalty to a chaotic and controlling family.
The sports drama explores addiction, ambition, sibling bonds, self-belief, and breaking unhealthy patterns.

name: Billy Elliot
description:
A boy in a struggling mining town discovers a passion for ballet despite social expectations.
The coming-of-age drama explores talent, masculinity, family sacrifice, and pursuing an unconventional dream.

name: Almost Famous
description:
A teenage writer joins a rising rock band on tour and sees the reality behind its glamorous image.
The coming-of-age drama explores music, belonging, integrity, friendship, and disillusionment.

name: The Blues Brothers
description:
Two musical brothers reunite their old band to raise money for the home that raised them.
The action comedy celebrates rhythm and blues through wild chases, deadpan humor, and joyful performances.

name: Moulin Rouge!
description:
A young writer falls for a celebrated performer inside a dazzling Paris nightclub.
The romantic musical combines pop songs, theatrical spectacle, artistic idealism, jealousy, and tragedy.

name: A Star Is Born
description:
A successful musician helps a talented singer find fame as his own stability begins to collapse.
The romantic music drama explores creativity, addiction, ambition, love, and unequal paths through success.

name: Chicago
description:
Two accused performers compete for celebrity and public sympathy in a sensational murder trial.
The musical satire examines fame, media manipulation, ambition, and justice as entertainment.
